summary: Restructure the assistant so it cannot cover the PDF, and add markdown rendering. The panel is docked as a real flex column inside the reader instead of a fixed overlay, the pages re-fit on dock/undock and on resize, the floating orb is always visible again (the rule that hid it was the cause of 'no orb'), and abstract/AI text renders markdown via a small escape-first renderer. server_version bumped to 0.4 and shown in the footer.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit c599320. Static UI + server version; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Layout/markdown work only; no model call and no budget/config change.
budget_impact.before: Assistant overlaid the reader via fixed positioning and a margin hack; orb could stay hidden; plain-text abstracts/answers.
budget_impact.after: Assistant docked in the reader flex row with automatic re-fit; orb always visible; markdown rendering.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Dock width and markdown spacing are not visually verified.
Markdown renderer is minimal (no tables/nested lists).
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
